caption:
Where do you take your sorrow?

Yaqub did not complain to people. He took it to Allah.

Surah Yusuf 12:86

Whisper your worry to Allah tonight

#quranreels #sabr #prophetyaqub

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
alt_text: He said, “I only complain of my anguish and sorrow to Allah, and I know from Allah what you do not know (Surah Yusuf 12:86)
